qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of the user attribute mapping in the SAP HANA driver?
qa_pairs.output: In the SAP HANA driver, the user attribute mapping defines how attributes stored in SAP HANA are translated to NetIQ Directory Server (NDS) attribute names. This mapping enables NetIQ Identity Manager to correctly read, interpret, and synchronize user information such as names, email addresses, group memberships, and login status between SAP HANA and NDS.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which SAP HANA attribute names correspond to which NDS attribute names in the SAP HANA driver?
qa_pairs.output:
The SAP HANA driver uses the following attribute mappings:

| SAP HANA Attribute Name | NDS-Name |
|--------------------------|-----------|
| USER_NAME               | CN |
| COMMENTS                | Description |
| USERGROUP_NAME          | Group Membership |
| USER_MODE               | employeeType |
| USER_DEACTIVATED        | Login Disabled |
| EMAIL ADDRESS           | Internet EMail Address |

These mappings determine how each SAP HANA attribute is represented in NDS.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you map the SAP HANA USER_NAME attribute to an NDS attribute in the SAP HANA driver?
qa_pairs.output: To map the SAP HANA USER_NAME attribute to an NDS attribute in the SAP HANA driver, set the mapping so that USER_NAME corresponds to the NDS attribute CN. This tells the driver to treat the value of USER_NAME as the common name (CN) of the user in NDS.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you configure the SAP HANA driver to recognise a disabled user based on the USER_DEACTIVATED attribute?
qa_pairs.output: In the SAP HANA driver, configure the attribute mapping so that the SAP HANA attribute USER_DEACTIVATED is mapped to the NDS attribute Login Disabled. When USER_DEACTIVATED is set, the driver will treat the user as disabled for login activities in NDS.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key user attribute mappings defined for the SAP HANA driver.
qa_pairs.output: The SAP HANA driver defines a set of user attribute mappings that align SAP HANA fields with NetIQ Directory Server attributes. USER_NAME maps to CN, COMMENTS to Description, USERGROUP_NAME to Group Membership, USER_MODE to employeeType, USER_DEACTIVATED to Login Disabled, and EMAIL ADDRESS to Internet EMail Address. These mappings enable seamless synchronization of user identity data between SAP HANA and NDS.
